parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no usable structural evidence: `members` is an empty array, and all fields under `structural_evidence` (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without field lists, method signatures, or shared-member counts for `MetalWallpaperView` and `MetalWallpaperRenderer`, there is no grounded basis on which to recommend a refactor. The two types occupy sibling files in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Renderers/` and their names suggest an intentional view/renderer separation rather than accidental duplication. Any action recommendation would require inventing evidence not present in the cluster row.
